hints.title: Hardcoded delays are on the critical path
hints.finding: 1.0s (10%) of this load is fixed UniTask.Delay-style gates.
hints.fixAdvice: These are free wins — replace fixed delays with event-driven readiness (SOAP events / NetworkVariable callbacks) or shrink the constants.

hints.title: One cost dominates this load
hints.finding: "Cell swap: the retired world is released (500 prisms a frame)" alone is 83% of the load (8.0s).
hints.fixAdvice: See the hot-path breakdown for its per-stage costs. Cut its workload (content/intensity tuning), pool or pre-instantiate its prefabs, or spread the work across frames.

hints.title: A single frame froze for over a second
hints.finding: Worst frame: 2.3s during "Cell swap: the retiring world suctions away (1.1s)".
hints.fixAdvice: That work runs synchronously in one frame — spread it across frames (coroutine/UniTask batches) or pool/preload the assets.
